title: Balderton x Revolut: 10 Year Celebration
description:
2025 marks a decade since Nik Storonsky and Vladyslav Y. founded Revolut, and a decade since Balderton led the company's first ever funding round - a £1.5M seed investment. Revolut is today one of the greatest startup success stories ever to come out of Europe. 

It was a joy to bring together Revolut leaders past and present for an evening to celebrate, reconnect and reminisce at Balderton HQ last month. And a particular pleasure to welcome so many Revolut alumni who have since gone on to found new companies - many of whom we have backed including Fuse Energy, Tilt, Grasp and more.
